_comment: Reference manifest for the App Store scenes. Each scene relaunches the app with `-SCREENSHOT_MODE -SCREENSHOT_SCENE <scene>`, which builds the deterministic state in ScreenshotSupport.swift (onboarding step or a demo weigh-in). No taps are needed — every scene is reached directly from launch args. Scripts/generate-screenshots.sh is the authoritative orchestrator; keep this file in sync with it.
